Here is only what matters in this part.

**Why this series exists**
Casey is making Handmade Hero, a full game written in C from scratch, live. He will not stop that series to teach the basics. These Intro to C videos teach the basics first, so you can follow along later.

**Why Visual Studio**
Windows does not come with a C compiler. Microsoft's compiler comes inside Visual Studio, so Casey installs that. You only need it for a few of its parts, not the whole program.

**What to install today**
Casey's version is very old now. Install the free **Visual Studio Community** edition. When the installer asks, choose **"Desktop development with C++"**.

**The parts you need from it**
- **cl.exe** is the compiler. It turns your C text into an object file.
- **link.exe** is the linker. It joins the object files into a .exe.
- **Debugger** lets you watch your program while it runs.

You can ignore the other tools for now.

**Keep this picture in mind for the whole video:**
text file → compiler → object file → linker → .exe → Windows runs it
